'''Anvaere Damodred''' is a [[Cairhien]]in noblewoman of [[House Damodred]]. She is the daughter of [[Dalresin Damodred]], sister of [[Innloine Damodred|Innloine]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]], and the half-sister of [[Taringail Damodred]].{{ref/book|0|6}}

== History ==
After the death of King [[Laman Damodred]] in the [[Aiel War]], Moiraine discounted Anvaere as a potential successor to the [[Sun Throne]] when questioned by [[Jarna Malari]]. Moiraine noted that her sister cared for little other than horses and hawking and considered that no one would trust her temper as queen.{{ref/book|0|6}}

When Moiraine escaped the [[White Tower]] after the [[Aes Sedai]] planned to make her queen, the Sun Throne passed from House Damodred, and [[Galldrian Riatin]] became the new King of Cairhien.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Galldrian su Riatin Rie}}

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Anvaere Damodred}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Lindsay Duncan}}.
